data.title: Dismissal from Beispieloptik Saaletal GmbH
data.summary: Beispieloptik Saaletal GmbH gives notice of termination (Kündigung) of Kevin Exempelroda's employment, which began on 1 March 2017, effective 28 February 2027, due to relocation of production and the resulting loss of his department's work. The letter was handed to him in person at the workplace on 18 November 2026.
data.explanation: Your employer has terminated your employment contract for operational reasons (relocation of production), effective 28 February 2027. The works council (Betriebsrat) did not object. If you want to challenge whether the dismissal is valid, you must file a lawsuit (Klage) with the labour court (Arbeitsgericht) - the letter states this must happen within three weeks of receipt; the app will show you the exact deadline. If you miss it, the dismissal becomes legally final even if it was unlawful. Separately, register as job-seeking with the employment agency (Agentur für Arbeit) as soon as possible to avoid any disadvantages for unemployment benefits. You will receive your reference letter (Arbeitszeugnis) together with your final payslip. Consider consulting a lawyer specialised in employment law given the short deadline.
